events.verdict: Eason (HOU) makes contact with Avdija's (POR) arm as he defends the jump shot attempt.
Adams (HOU) establishes himself in Love's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Avdija (POR) is out of bounds when he makes contact with the ball.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.
Avdija (POR) and Eason (HOU) come together as they pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Durant (HOU) goes to, not through, Camara's (POR) space as he releases away from the contact.
Thompson (HOU) moves alongside Avdija's (POR) path as he defends the drive.
Adams (HOU) legally contests Love's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Clingan (POR) brushes Smith Jr.'s (HOU) arm as he pursues the rebound.
Camara (POR) moves alongside Durant's (HOU) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Durant (HOU) initiates contact with Avdija's (POR) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Camara (POR) releases away from Smith Jr. (HOU) to pursue the long rebound.
Durant (HOU) moves alongside Avdija's (POR) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Smith Jr. (HOU) does not step out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Camara (POR) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Camara is late to the spot and does not establish a legal guarding position in Thompson's (HOU) path prior to the contact.
Cissoko (POR) commits a take foul on Durant (HOU).

Replay review of the foul called on Eason (HOU) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Eason cleanly deflects the ball away from Love (POR), and the ensuing body contact is considered incidental.
Rupert (POR) moves alongside Durant's (HOU) path as he defends the drive.
Avdija (POR) and Rupert (POR) legally contest Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
